From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Launch readiness: enablement punchlist + QBR prep

Team —

As discussed in leadership: we need a concise cross-functional punchlist to drive the last 10 business days before the BrightLane pilot goes live and to shape our QBR narrative. I put together an initial enablement-focused checklist (attached) but want updates from each owner below by EOD Friday so I can fold into the QBR deck. Please treat this as the single source of truth for go/no-go asks.

Top-line asks (please include status, owner, blockers, ETA):
- GTM materials: battlecards, 1-pager, two demo scripts (owner: laura_bennett) — link the canonical playbook and confirm demo owners.
- Enablement: training slides + internal playbook for CS/AM (owner: kimberly_park) — finalize trainings and record quick-run video.
- Pricing & trials: approved discount tiers and trial onboarding flow (owner: marcus_lin) — note any approval windows that affect launch.
- Docs: customer-facing onboarding guide + troubleshooting KB (owner: marissa_cole) — call out 1-3 gaps.
- Support readiness: escalation matrix and on-call rotations for week 1 (owner: rishi_malhotra) — confirm SLOs and runbook links.

Attachments: enablement-punchlist-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

I will assemble the QBR slide draft Wednesday and circulate for comments; please add any slide text into the draft (I’ll post link once I have it). If any of these items are at risk of slipping past Nov 16 (pilot cutover), flag with a red tag and proposed mitigation.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Enablement | Redwood Inference

2) Onboarding checklist for pilot customers (customer-facing) — Marissa, I tagged the doc folder with a TODO for the single-page checklist; can you confirm you’ll drop that into the onboarding guide?

Otherwise playbook review looks good. I’ve added a short list of demo Q&A we should surface in training.

Subject: Re: Launch readiness: enablement punchlist + QBR prep — final decisions + next steps

Team / BrightLane —

Thanks for the quick turn. Summarizing decisions and owners so we have a single source of truth before QBR: 

Decisions: 
- Trial length confirmed: 30 days (Marcus). Discount tiers will not be public; proposals only.
- Onboarding fee credit: approved as a one-time exception for BrightLane (Finance to issue credit memo month 1) — Rishi to confirm by Mon 11/09.
- Docs: Marissa will deliver the quickstart checklist and the rate-limit runbook (SUP-4521) by Tue 11/10.
- Enablement: internal training slide deck and a 10-minute recorded demo will be posted by Wed 11/11.
- Support: Rishi to share the escalation matrix and the on-call rota (week 1) by Mon 11/09; emergency contact will include a direct phone number and a dedicated pilot inbox.

Deliverables I uploaded: enablement-punchlist-v2.xlsx (finalized entries), QBR-slide-deck-draft.pdf (please add slide text inline). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B.../enablement

Next steps: please review the deck and add 2 bullets max per slide. I’ll run a dry-run of the QBR narrative on Wed morning (invite to follow). If anything is at risk of missing the agreed dates above, mark with RED in the punchlist and notify me immediately.

Thanks everyone — excellent cross-functional response here. BrightLane, we’ll share the onboarding checklist first thing Monday morning.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Enablement | Redwood Inference
